# PocketRun (`feature/file-manager`) — Research Report

Repo root: `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code` · branch `feature/file-manager` · HEAD `d5c9f92 "Show the files inside a project"` · working tree clean.

Stack: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, CPython 3.13 via Chaquopy 17, Rhino 1.8.1 + a hand-written Node layer (`assets/node/boot.js`), a custom npm client, an "opencode"-style agent with 13 tools, GitHub REST + Actions integration, in-app APK updater.

---

## 1. FILE MANAGER UI

### 1.1 Files involved

| Path | Lines | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/ProjectsScreen.kt` | 703 | The file manager screen (tab 0). Composables: `ProjectsScreen` (86), `FileToolbar` (403), `TreeRow` (481), `FileActionBar` (519), `SearchResults` (593), `NameDialog` (633), `ConfirmDialog` (668), `iconFor` (683), `EntryDialog` (698) |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/AppViewModel.kt` | 1602 | All state/handlers: `openFile` (931), `toggleFolder` (893), `inspect` (921), `rebuildTree` (820), `rebuildTreeAsync` (834), `refreshFiles` (838), `startWatching` (856), `openInEditor` (941), `showPreview` (1144), `openExternally` (1100), `shareFile` (1109) |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/core/FileTree.kt` | 224 | `FileKind` (11), `FileNode` (23), `TreeFilter` (37), `FileTree.build` (129), `walk` (137), `fingerprint` (206), `SKIP_DIRS` (56) |
| `/home/runner/hub-work/pocketrun/code/android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/FileViewer.kt` | 301 | `FileViewerDialog` (66), `ImageViewer`, `AudioViewer`, `VideoViewer`, `OtherViewer` |

All UI strings are hardcoded Russian in Kotlin — `android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` contains only `app_name`.

### 1.2 The "Открыть" / "Открыть папку" button — exact code path

The button lives in the bottom action bar that appears for the *inspected* entry (selected by long-press):

`ProjectsScreen.kt:283-294`
```kotlin
if (inspected != null) {
    FileActionBar(
        file = inspected!!,
        onOpen = { viewModel.openFile(inspected!!) },   // <-- line 286
        onRename = { dialog = EntryDialog.Rename(inspected!!) },
        ...
```

`ProjectsScreen.kt:543-546` — the button itself
```kotlin
Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
    OutlinedButton(onClick = onOpen, contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp)) {
        Text(if (file.isDirectory) "Открыть папку" else "Открыть", fontSize = 13.sp)
    }
```

Click path: `onOpen` → `AppViewModel.openFile` → `AppViewModel.toggleFolder` → `AppViewModel.rebuildTreeAsync()` → (guard) → `FileTree.build`.

`AppViewModel.kt:926-939`
```kotlin
/**
 * Opens a file the way its type asks for: a folder expands, code and text go
 * to the editor, and everything else goes to the built-in viewer or, when
 * there is nothing to show it with, to a system app.
 */
fun openFile(file: File) {
    _inspected.value = file
    val kind = FileTree.kindOf(file)
    when {
        kind == FileKind.FOLDER -> toggleFolder(file)   // <-- folders never navigate
        FileTree.isTextual(kind) -> openInEditor(file)  // requests tab 1
        else -> showPreview(file)
    }
}
```

`AppViewModel.kt:893-898`
```kotlin
fun toggleFolder(file: File) {
    val path = file.absolutePath
    _expandedDirs.value =
        if (path in _expandedDirs.value) _expandedDirs.value - path else _expandedDirs.value + path
    rebuildTreeAsync()          // <-- force = false
}
```

Note: for a folder, `openFile` **only flips a set membership**. There is no navigation: no "current directory" state, no breadcrumb, no "go up". The tree is always rooted at `selected.dir` (`AppViewModel.kt:821`, `:830`). Contrast with a text file, which sets `_tabRequest.value = TAB_EDITOR` (`AppViewModel.kt:954`) and the tab bar actually switches (`App.kt:55-62`).

### 1.3 Why opening a folder does not work — the fingerprint guard bug (primary cause)

`AppViewModel.kt:815-836`
```kotlin
private fun rebuildTree(force: Boolean = false) {
    val dir = _selected.value?.dir
    if (dir == null) { treePrint = ""; if (_tree.value.isNotEmpty()) _tree.value = emptyList(); return }
    val print = FileTree.fingerprint(dir)
    if (!force && print == treePrint) return          // <-- line 828: THE BUG
    treePrint = print
    _tree.value = FileTree.build(dir, _expandedDirs.value, _treeFilter.value)
}

private fun rebuildTreeAsync(force: Boolean = false) {
    ioExecutor.execute { rebuildTree(force) }
}
```

`FileTree.fingerprint` (`FileTree.kt:206-223`) hashes only names, lengths and mtimes. It is **completely independent of `_expandedDirs` and `_treeFilter`**. Therefore:

1. `select()` → `rebuildTreeAsync(force = true)` (`:1277`) → `treePrint = P`, tree built collapsed.
2. User long-presses a folder → `inspect()` (`:921-924`) → the bottom bar appears. Tree unchanged.
3. User taps **"Открыть папку"** → `openFile` → `toggleFolder` → `_expandedDirs += path`, `rebuildTreeAsync()` with `force = false` → line 828 short-circuits (`P == treePrint`) → **`_tree` is never reassigned → the folder's children never appear.**
4. The 2-second watcher cannot rescue it either — `startWatching` calls plain `rebuildTree()` (`:862`), which also short-circuits on the same fingerprint.
5. Tapping again flips the set back (toggle), still no rebuild.

So the only things that make the folder actually open are an **unrelated** disk write inside the project (agent writing a file, an editor save, an import, create/rename/delete — all `force = true`) or the manual **"Обновить"** button (`ProjectsScreen.kt:115` → `AppViewModel.refreshFiles()` → `rebuildTreeAsync(force = true)`, `:838-841`).

**Misleading UI:** `_expandedDirs` is its own `StateFlow` that *does* update, and `ProjectsScreen.kt:266` passes `expanded = node.file.absolutePath in expanded` into `TreeRow`, which flips the icon to `Icons.Filled.FolderOpen` / contentDescription "Свернуть" (`ProjectsScreen.kt:509-515`). Result: the row shows an *open folder* icon with **zero children listed** — the UI actively asserts it worked.

### 1.4 The same bug affects every filter control

All of these call `rebuildTreeAsync()` **without** `force`:

| Handler | Line | UI control |
|---|---|---|
| `toggleFolder` | 897 | "Открыть папку" / tree row tap |
| `setTreeQuery` | 902 | "поиск по имени" text field (`ProjectsScreen.kt:420`) |
| `setTreeKind` | 907 | kind filter chips (`ProjectsScreen.kt:206-210`) |
| `toggleHiddenFiles` | 912 | dotfile toggle button (`ProjectsScreen.kt:451`) |
| `clearTreeFilter` | 918 | "сбросить фильтр" chip (`ProjectsScreen.kt:464`) |

So typing in the name filter, switching the kind chip, or toggling hidden files is also a visual no-op until the folder contents change on disk. `contentMode` search (`searchContent`, `:1188`) does work because it bypasses the tree entirely.

### 1.5 Secondary problems in the folder-open path

1. **Toggle semantics on a button labelled "Открыть папку".** Because the row tap already calls `openFile` (→ toggle), the sequence "tap row (expands) → tap Открыть папку (collapses)" is inverted once the guard bug is fixed. Two entry points share one toggle action.
2. **Dead long-press handler.** `TreeRow` declares `onLongPress` (`ProjectsScreen.kt:481`) and `ProjectsScreen.kt:268` passes `viewModel.inspect(node.file)`, but the body only binds `.clickable(onClick = onClick)` (`ProjectsScreen.kt:485`) — `onLongPress` is never referenced (no `combinedClickable`/`onLongClick` anywhere in the file). So there is no way to inspect an entry without also opening it; the only real way `inspected` gets set for a folder is through `openFile` itself.
3. **No `LaunchedEffect`/`derivedStateOf`** anywhere in `ProjectsScreen.kt` — nothing reacts to `expandedDirs`/`treeFilter` changing. The rebuild is entirely ViewModel-driven.
4. **No test coverage.** There is no `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/` directory at all. `FileTreeTest.kt:54-63` proves `FileTree.build` honours an expanded set correctly, so the defect is exclusively in `AppViewModel.rebuildTree`.

### 1.6 What does work in the screen (for contrast)

- Per-node folder/file counts (`FileTree.node`, `FileTree.kt:157-171`).
- Content search (`ContentSearch.search`, `AppViewModel.kt:1188-1207`) — bypasses the tree.
- Create / create folder / rename / delete (`ProjectsScreen.kt:297-343`), with `FileOps` name validation and history snapshots on delete (`AppViewModel.kt:1010`).
- Import from the phone via SAF `OpenMultipleDocuments` (`ProjectsScreen.kt:105-109`, `AppViewModel.importFromPhone` `:1053`) — no storage permission, 512 MB cap (`:1565`).
- Share / hand to another app via `FileProvider` (`:1109-1140`).
- Built-in image/audio/video/other viewer + "Открыть системным приложением" fallback (`FileViewer.kt:296`, `AppViewModel.kt:1100`).
- Disk-change watcher + editor conflict banner (`AppViewModel.kt:856-891`, `EditorScreen.kt:150-166`).

---

## 2. RUNTIME / JS

### 2.1 `assets/node` contents — the whole bundle is one file

```
android/app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js      46 203 bytes   1 061 lines
```

That is the **only** file in `android/app/src/main/assets/`. No `node_modules`, no vendored packages, no pre-installed binaries, no `package.json`, no tarball cache. It is loaded as a string:

`AppViewModel.kt:188-194`
```kotlin
val jsRuntime: JsRuntime by lazy {
    val boot = getApplication<Application>().assets.open("node/boot.js")
        .bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
    JsRuntime(boot, workspace)
}
val npxRuntime: NpxRuntime by lazy { NpxRuntime(jsRuntime, workspace) }
```

`JsRuntime.VERSION = "Rhino 1.8.1 (ES6,interpreted)"` (`JsRuntime.kt:58`). Dependency: `implementation("org.mozilla:rhino:1.8.1")` (`build.gradle.kts:213`).

### 2.2 How the JS runtime is set up

`runtime/js/JsRuntime.kt` (477 lines):

- Single daemon worker thread `pocketrun-js-run` (`:61-63`); runs serialized because Rhino contexts are not shareable.
- `runLocked` (`:148-224`): `Context.enter()`, `languageVersion = VERSION_ES6`, `optimizationLevel = -1` (required on Android), `initSafeStandardObjects()`, `installBridge(...)`, then `cx.evaluateString(scope, bootSource, "boot.js", ...)` (`:155`).
- Entry module: `__setMainDir(dir)` (`:161`) then `evaluateString(source)` (`:166`).
- Event loop after the main script returns, driven by boot.js hooks `__prPending` / `__prNextDue` / `__prRunDue` / `__prExitCode` / `__prOnExit` (`:185-216`), with a hard `maxRunMs = 10 min` cap (`:49`, `:180`).
- Bridge `__pr` installed as `BaseFunction` subclasses (NOT `javaToJS`), so the safe scope never sees Java objects (`:260-273`). Kotlin `null` is deliberately mapped to JS `null`, not `undefined` (`:266-268`).
- Output via `workspace/cache/runs/<uuid>/out.log|err.log` + two `OutputTailer`s (`:84-91`), mirroring PythonRuntime.
- `executeSync(request, timeoutMs)` (`:130-144`) → used by the agent's `bash` tool and the editor.
- Entry script is re-validated through `Workspace.resolve` (`readMainSource`, `:232-238`), and shebangs are stripped (`:237`).

### 2.3 npm packages: **downloaded on demand, nothing vendored**

`runtime/npm/` implements a mini npm client against `https://registry.npmjs.org/`:

| File | Lines | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `NpmRegistry.kt` | 190 | HTTP to the registry. `metadata(name)` (`:29`), `downloadTarball(url, dest, integrity)` (`:49`). Hardened: **`dist.integrity` is mandatory** (`:71-82`, refuses metadata without a digest), **sha512/384/256/1** (`:188`), tarball must be **https** and on the **same host as the registry** (`:112-127`), failing tarball deleted (`:57`). UA `pocketrun-npm/1.2 (Rhino)` (`:172`). |
| `NpxRuntime.kt` | 371 | Spec parsing (`parseSpec` `:43`, `parseCommandLine` `:56`), install into `workspace/packages/<name>` (`install` `:204`), dependency tree with hoisting + nesting on conflict (`installDependencies` `:245`, `installInto` `:280`), limits `MAX_PACKAGES = 40`, `MAX_DEPTH = 4` (`:38-39`), version resolution incl. dist-tags (`chooseVersion` `:331`), `bin` resolution re-validated through `Workspace.resolve` (`:353-370`), `uninstall` (`:313`), `installedPackages()` (`:89`). |
| `TarReader.kt` | 127 | Minimal ustar `.tgz` reader. Strips `package/`, skips symlinks/pax/long-names (`:50`), rejects absolute and `..` paths (`:115-116`), forces every path under dest (`:121-126`). |
| `Semver.kt` | 200 | semver parse/compare, `^ ~ >= <`, x-ranges, `\|\|`, prerelease rules. |

Install root: `Workspace.packages = <filesDir>/workspace/packages` (`Workspace.kt:16`). `boot.js:1008-1022` (`resolveInNodeModules`) walks up looking in `node_modules/` **and** in `packages/` — that is the only reason a top-level install is visible to `require()`.

Explicit omissions, documented in code: **native addons and postinstall scripts are skipped** (`NpxRuntime.kt:28-29`), and packages using `class` / `async` / `import` fail to parse (Rhino limitation) — surfaced with a hint at `NpxRuntime.kt:189-195` ("try cowsay@1.4.0 instead of cowsay@latest").

### 2.4 Python runtime (for contrast)

`runtime/python/PythonRuntime.kt` (238 lines): Chaquopy, started once from `PocketRunApplication.onCreate` (`PythonRuntime.initAsync`, `:46-65`). Target + cwd resolved through `Workspace.resolve` (`:112-118`). Cancellation is cooperative only → exit code 130 (`:152`, documented `:91-93`). **Python packages are build-time only** — there is no `pip` at runtime (`docs/PLAN.md:55-64`, `OpenCodeAgent.kt:224`).

`runtime/Exec.kt` (58 lines) holds `RuntimeKind{PYTHON,NODE,NPX}`, `ExecRequest`, `ExecResult`, `OutputListener`, `ExecutionHandle`, `ScriptRuntime`. `runtime/OutputTailer.kt` (146 lines) tails the log files.

## 4. NETWORK / DOWNLOAD

All networking is plain `java.net.HttpURLConnection`/`URL` (no OkHttp, no WorkManager, no DownloadManager). `INTERNET` + `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are the only network permissions.

| Consumer | Endpoint | Mechanism | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| **npm registry client** | `https://registry.npmjs.org/` (default `baseUrl`, overridable) | packument JSON + `.tgz` download, integrity-verified, host-pinned | `NpmRegistry.kt:24,29,49,112,163` |
| **npm installer** | same | downloads tarball → `TarReader.extract` into `workspace/packages/`, recursive deps | `NpxRuntime.kt:204-311` |
| **npm via agent `bash`** | same | `npm install` → `NpxRuntime.install` | `MiniShell.kt:488-518` |
| **`http`/`https` from JS scripts** | any http(s) | synchronous bridge call, 15 s connect / 60 s read, 4 MB body cap | `JsRuntime.kt:364-370, 398-447` |
| **`webfetch` tool** | any http(s) | 10 s / 30 s, UA `Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)` | `OpenCodeTools.kt:428-446` |
| **GitHub REST (agent tool)** | `https://api.github.com` | repos, files, workflows, dispatch, runs, run_wait, logs, artifacts, arbitrary `api` | `GitHubClient.kt` (484 lines) |
| **Remote opencode instructions** | any http(s) from `opencode.json` | 5 s timeout, 48 KB cap | `Instructions.kt:103-112` |
| **LLM chat + model list** | user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint | SSE streaming `POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions`, `GET /models` | `LlmClient.kt:66,226,276,312` |
| **In-app APK updater** | `https://api.github.com/repos/{BuildConfig.UPDATE_REPO}/releases/latest` → `browser_download_url` | `.part` file then rename, progress callback, 512 MB cap; installed via `ACTION_VIEW` + `FileProvider` | `AppUpdater.kt:20,40,118`; `AppViewModel.kt:1473,1497,1513` |
| **License** | **none** | fully offline Ed25519; the shared key is baked into the APK | `LicenseManager.kt`, `build.gradle.kts:71-72,183-191` |

### 4.1 Package-manager / registry integration — the "install package" capability

There is exactly **one** package-manager integration and it is **npm-only, JS-only, pure-JS-only**:

- Entry points: `npx` in the bash tool (`MiniShell.kt:436`), `npm install` in the bash tool (`MiniShell.kt:488`), and the **NPX editor tab** (`EditorScreen.kt:167-192`, `AppViewModel.npxCommand` default `"cowsay@1.4.0 Привет, PocketRun!"` `:152`, `runNpxCommand` `:1392-1411`).
- No agent-facing `install`/`npm_install` tool exists — the model must go through `bash`.
- **No Python `pip` at runtime** (stdlib only; pip packages are a build-time Chaquopy concern, `docs/PLAN.md:55-64`, `OpenCodeAgent.kt:224`).
- No lockfile, no integrity pinning beyond `dist.integrity`, no cache eviction (`NpxRuntime.kt:213-219` reuses an install whose version satisfies the range), no offline mode, no mirror configuration in the UI (the `baseUrl` parameter exists but nothing surfaces it — `NpmRegistry.kt:24`).
- Install budget `MAX_PACKAGES = 40`, depth `MAX_DEPTH = 4` per run (`NpxRuntime.kt:38-39, 220, 253, 290`).

### 4.2 Update mechanism

`checkUpdateOnStart()` (`AppViewModel.kt:1546-1555`) fires **once per 24 h** (`CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `:1559`), gated on an active license, timestamp persisted in the `"updates"` SharedPreferences. Called from the UI when the license becomes active (`App.kt:35-37`). Asset selection prefers `*-release.apk` and rejects debug (`AppUpdate.kt:22,44-51`). Download → `cacheDir/updates/` (`:1538`) → `FileProvider` authority `${applicationId}.updates` → `ACTION_VIEW` with `application/vnd.android.package-archive`. Nothing installs itself; the system installer asks the user. `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` is declared (`AndroidManifest.xml:7`).

### 5.4 What escapes the sandbox (intentionally, all user-mediated)

1. **Share / "open with" a project file** — `ACTION_SEND` / `ACTION_VIEW` with `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION` and a one-shot `FileProvider` grant scoped to `workspace/` (`AppViewModel.kt:1109-1131`; `res/xml/share_paths.xml`).
2. **APK update install** — `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` + `FileProvider` authority `.updates` scoped to `cache/updates/` (`AppViewModel.kt:1513-1526`; `res/xml/update_paths.xml`).
3. **Import from the phone** — SAF `OpenMultipleDocuments` via the system picker; read through `ContentResolver`, no storage permission (`AppViewModel.kt:1048-1076`).
4. **Remote effects with the user's own credentials** — the `github` tool can create repos, push code, dispatch workflows and run commands on GitHub-hosted runners using the user's PAT from `AgentSettings` (`OpenCodeTools.kt:472-529`). This is the widest blast radius in the app: the agent can execute arbitrary shell **on someone else's CI machine** (`OpenCodeAgent.kt:246-271` even ships a ready-made workflow YAML that installs `opencode-ai` globally and runs it). Gated only by `MODE_MANUAL` approval (auto mode = no prompt).
5. **Outbound network to arbitrary hosts** — `webfetch` (`:428-446`), the JS `http`/`https` bridge (`JsRuntime.kt:398-431`), and remote instructions URLs from `opencode.json` (`Instructions.kt:103-112`).

### 5.5 Repo-hygiene finding (outside the app, but relevant to "global state")

The release signing material and the shared license key are **committed to git**, not just present locally:

```
android/keystore.properties      (tracked)
android/keystore/release.p12    (tracked)  — 2 710 bytes, password "pocketrun"
android/shared-license.key      (tracked)  — a valid PRK1 Ed25519 license, plan=pro, no expiry
android/license.pubkey           (tracked)
hub-snapshot-builds/*.apk        (tracked)  — 35.8 MB debug + 18.9 MB release
```

`git check-ignore` reports none of them as ignored — `.gitignore:3-6` lists `keystore.properties`, `*.jks`, `*.keystore`, but tracking wins over gitignore, and `.p12` is not listed at all. `build.gradle.kts:174-191` even documents the shared key as *"public by design — the license gate is a formality here, not a protection"*, and `.github/workflows/build-hub-snapshot.yml:115-127` pulls the keystore pair from the default branch by raw URL. Anyone with read access to the repo can produce an update-signed APK.

---

## 6. BUILD / TEST

### 6.1 Local commands

Wrapper: `android/gradlew` (Gradle **8.11.1**, `android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties`). Separate JVM project: `tools/keygen/gradlew` (same wrapper version). AGP 8.7.3, Kotlin 2.0.21, Chaquopy 17.0.0 (`android/build.gradle.kts`). JDK 17 required; Python **3.13** on the build machine for Chaquopy `.pyc` precompilation (`build.gradle.kts:142-159`).

```bash
# Unit tests (JVM, no emulator)
cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testDebugUnitTest

# Python sandbox jail tests (plain CPython, no emulator)
python3 -m unittest discover -s android/app/src/test/python -v

# Build
cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleRelease     # needs android/keystore.properties

# License keygen self-test
tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen test

# Issue a license key
tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="issue --name 'Jane Doe' --seat laptop --plan pro --days 30"
```

`android/build.gradle.kts:49-58` makes `packageRelease` fail with a clear `GradleException` if `android/keystore.properties` is missing. `build.gradle.kts:137-147` sets `unitTests.isReturnDefaultValues = true` and forces `LANG=C.UTF-8` for all `Test` tasks (JVM `sun.jnu.encoding` is ASCII on a C-locale runner, and boot.js tests write Cyrillic filenames).

### 6.2 Test inventory (24 files, JVM unit tests)

| Path | Tests |
|---|---|
| `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/LlmClientTest.kt` (271) + `FakeHttpServer.kt` (111) | streaming/tool-call parsing |
| `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/AgentSettingsTest.kt` (85) | config |
| `agent/opencode/OpenCodeAgentTest.kt` (228), `OpenCodeToolsGateTest.kt` (151), `MiniShellTest.kt` (197), `ApplyPatchTest.kt` (154), `SessionsTest.kt` (140), `SkillsTest.kt` (108), `InstructionsTest.kt` (96), `HistoryTrimmerTest.kt` (121) | agent + tools + shell |
| `runtime/js/JsRuntimeTest.kt` (353) | real boot.js integration; reads `src/main/assets/node/boot.js` or `app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js` relative to the module dir (`:26-31`) |
| `runtime/npm/NpxRuntimeTest.kt` (151), `SemverTest.kt` (99), `TarReaderTest.kt` (139) | npm client |
| `core/FileOpsTest.kt` (204), `FileTreeTest.kt` (104), `WorkspaceTest.kt` (134) | file layer |
| `license/LicenseFormatTest.kt` (143), `MonotonicClockTest.kt` (99), `SharedLicenseTest.kt` (43) | license (golden vectors shared with `tools/keygen`) |
| `update/AppUpdateTest.kt` (80) | release parsing / version compare |
| `android/app/src/test/python/test_pocketrun.py` | the audit-hook jail |
| `tools/keygen/src/test/kotlin/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt` (141) | keygen |

**There is no `android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/ui/` directory** — `AppViewModel` (1602 lines, the file-manager state machine) and every Compose screen have **zero** unit tests, no Robolectric, no Compose UI tests, no instrumentation tests, no `androidTest` source set. The fingerprint-guard defect in §1.3 is exactly what that gap hides.

### 6.3 CI — `.github/workflows/`

**`android.yml`** — `Android`, triggers: push to any branch except `v*` tags, all PRs, `workflow_dispatch`. `ubuntu-24.04`, 60 min timeout, `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress`.
- checkout (`fetch-depth: 0`, `fetch-tags: true` — versionCode derives from the nearest tag)
- Temurin JDK 17; `setup-python` 3.13
- `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4`; Chaquopy cache (`~/.chaquopy`, `~/.gradle/caches/modules-2`)
- **`:app:testDebugUnitTest`** (`working-directory: android`)
- **`python3 -m unittest discover -s android/app/src/test/python -v`**
- `:app:assembleDebug`
- `:app:assembleRelease` only if secrets `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64/_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD` exist (writes `android/keystore.jks` + `android/keystore.properties` from the repo root on purpose, then `cd android && ./gradlew`)
- uploads `pocketrun-apk` artifact

Second job `keygen`: Temurin 17 + `./gradlew --no-daemon test` in `tools/keygen`.

**`release.yml`** — `Release`, triggers on `v*` tags and `workflow_dispatch` (input `tag`). `permissions: contents: write`. Same tests, then **hard-fails** without the keystore secret. Names assets `PocketRun-<tag>-release.apk` / `-debug.apk` (this is what `AppUpdate.APK_SUFFIX = "-release.apk"` looks for) and publishes via `gh release create/upload --clobber`. Release notes explain the shared-key situation and the daily in-app update check.

**`build-hub-snapshot.yml`** — manual only. `curl`s the NPM-Hub work-backup snapshot from `raw.githubusercontent.com/sj0404-collab/zen-panel@work-backup` (`repo.bundle` + `wip.patch` + `untracked.tar.gz` + `worktree.tar.gz`, with chunked large-blob reassembly and sha256 verification), pulls the signing keypair from the default branch by raw URL (`:115-127`), then `:app:assembleDebug` in `src/android`. Output artifact `pocketrun-snapshot-apk-<stamp>`.

### 6.4 Versioning

`versionCode = gitVersionCode()` — `major*1e6 + minor*1e3 + patch` from `git describe --tags --abbrev=0`, plus the commit count since that tag (`build.gradle.kts:21-45`); `versionName` from the tag with the `v` stripped (`:69`). `applicationIdSuffix = ".debug"` for debug builds (`:101`), so the debug APK is a genuinely different app id — which is why `AppUpdate` rejects debug-named assets.

### 6.5 `docs/PLAN.md` is stale

`docs/PLAN.md` still lists Node and npx as *"не начато"* (lines 17-18) although both are shipped and tested, and `MainActivity` as *"заглушка"* (line 137) although it is 15 lines of working code. 120:     /**

122:      *
123:      * Without a filter this walks only what the user has expanded, so a project
124:      * with thousands of files costs a directory listing per open folder. With a
125:      * filter the whole tree is walked once, and a folder is kept when the filter
126:      * matches it or anything inside it - that is what makes a search reveal a
127:      * file that sits in a collapsed folder.
128:      */
129:     fun build(root: File, expanded: Set<String>, filter: TreeFilter): List<FileNode> {
130:         if (!root.isDirectory) return emptyList()
131:         if (!filter.isFiltering) return walk(root, 0, expanded, filter.showHidden)
132:         val all = walk(root, 0, everythingExpanded = true, showHidden = filter.showHidden)
133:         val keep = keepSet(root, all, filter)
134:         return all.filter { it.file.absolutePath in keep }
135:     }
136: 
137:     private fun walk(
138:         dir: File,
139:         depth: Int,
140:         expanded: Set<String> = emptySet(),
141:         showHidden: Boolean = false,
142:         everythingExpanded: Boolean = false,
143:     ): List<FileNode> {
144:         if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) return emptyList()
145:         val out = ArrayList<FileNode>()
146:         for (child in children(dir, showHidden)) {
147:             if (out.size >= MAX_NODES) break
148:             val kind = kindOf(child)
149:             out += node(child, depth, kind)
150:             if (kind != FileKind.FOLDER) continue
151:             val open = everythingExpanded || child.absolutePath in expanded
152:             if (open) out += walk(child, depth + 1, expanded, showHidden, everythingExpanded)
153:         }
154:         return out
155:     }

157:     private fun node(file: File, depth: Int, kind: FileKind): FileNode {
158:         if (kind != FileKind.FOLDER) {

160:         }

164:             depth = depth,
165:             kind = kind,
166:             size = 0,
167:             modified = file.lastModified(),

169:             files = entries?.count { !it.isDirectory } ?: 0,
170:         )
171:     }

173:     private fun children(dir: File, showHidden: Boolean): List<File> {
174:         val entries = dir.listFiles() ?: return emptyList()

177:             .sortedWith(compareBy({ if (it.isDirectory) 0 else 1 }, { it.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }))
178:     }

181:     private fun keepSet(root: File, all: List<FileNode>, filter: TreeFilter): Set<String> {
182:         val query = filter.query.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
183:         val keep = HashSet<String>()
184:         for (node in all) {
185:             if (node.isFolder) continue
186:             val byName = query.isEmpty() || node.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).contains(query)
187:             val byKind = filter.kind == null || node.kind == filter.kind
188:             if (!byName || !byKind) continue
189:             keep += node.file.absolutePath
190:             var current = node.file.parentFile
191:             while (current != null && current.absolutePath.length >= root.absolutePath.length) {
192:                 keep += current.absolutePath
193:                 if (current.absolutePath == root.absolutePath) break
194:                 current = current.parentFile
195:             }
196:         }
197:         return keep
198:     }

202:      * editor or a file imported from the phone changed something while the app was
203:      * looking at it. Names, sizes and mtimes only - no nodes are built, so it is
204:      * safe to run every couple of seconds.
205:      */
206:     fun fingerprint(root: File): String {
207:         if (!root.isDirectory) return "-"
208:         var hash = 1125899906842597L
209:         var count = 0
210:         val stack = ArrayDeque<File>()
211:         stack.addLast(root)
212:         while (stack.isNotEmpty() && count < MAX_NODES) {
213:             val dir = stack.removeLast()
214:             for (child in dir.listFiles().orEmpty()) {
215:                 count++
216:                 if (child.isDirectory && child.name !in SKIP_DIRS) stack.addLast(child)
217:                 hash = hash * 31 + child.name.hashCode()
218:                 hash = hash * 31 + child.length()
219:                 hash = hash * 31 + child.lastModified()
220:             }
221:         }
222:         return "$count:${java.lang.Long.toHexString(hash)}"
223:     }

Now I understand the folder-open bug completely. The fix is straightforward: the fingerprint guard doesn't account for `expandedDirs` or `treeFilter`. 

Two options:
- A: Pass `force = true` from toggleFolder/setTreeQuery/etc.
- B: Include expanded+filter state in the guard key.

Option B is better: it keeps the cheap-guard benefit for the watcher (which calls `rebuildTree()` with no force) while making explicit state changes always rebuild. Actually simpler: track a `treeKey` = fingerprint + hash of expanded set + filter. Let me do B — it's cleaner and fixes all 5 call sites at once.

Actually, the simplest correct approach that preserves intent: make the guard key incorporate the view state.

```kotlin
private fun viewStamp(dir: File): String =
    FileTree.fingerprint(dir) + "|" + _expandedDirs.value.hashCode() + "|" + _treeFilter.value
```

Then `rebuildTree()` compares `stamp` to `treePrint`. If expanded set or filter changed, stamp changes → rebuild. And the watcher calls rebuildTree() every 2s — if nothing changed, stamp same → skip. 

But there's a subtlety: the watcher runs on watchExecutor while toggleFolder runs on ioExecutor — both call rebuildTree. Race on `treePrint` and `_tree.value`. Pre-existing. Let me not worry too much but the stamp approach is actually more robust.

Hmm, but also: is a tree-only expand enough for "открытие папок"? The user says "кнопка открыть не работает" — the Open button. With the fix, tapping "Открыть папку" expands the folder and shows children inline. That's probably what they want — a file manager tree. But they might also want real navigation (enter folder, breadcrumb, go up). Let me consider: the report says there's no navigation at all. The user said "добавляй открытие папок а то кнопка открыть не работает" — "add folder opening, because the open button doesn't work". 

The minimal correct interpretation: make the folder open work. Expanding inline in the tree IS opening. I'll do that (fix the guard), plus wire the dead `onLongPress` since without it there's no way to inspect a file without opening it (which makes the action bar's other buttons — rename/delete/history — unreachable for files). Actually wait: `openFile` sets `_inspected.value = file`, so tapping a row does set inspected. So the action bar appears. OK so long-press is a nice-to-have but not blocking.

Actually, let me reconsider — the long press IS important for folders. Because: tap row → openFile → toggleFolder → expands. Then the row shows FolderOpen. Then to inspect a folder you tap again → collapses. So you can never have a folder both open AND inspected without it being collapsed. With the guard bug, tapping "Открыть папку" appeared to work (icon changed) — that's the misleading UI the report describes. Once I fix the guard, tapping "Открыть папку" would collapse the already-expanded folder. So I need to fix this properly:

- `openFile` on a folder: ensure it's expanded (idempotent "open"), and scroll/inspect it. Not a toggle.
- Row tap on a folder: toggle (that's the natural chevron behavior).
- Action bar "Открыть папку" for a folder: expand + it's meaningful. And add a "Свернуть"/collapse? 

Better design: separate the two intents.
- Row click → `toggleFolder` (chevron-like expand/collapse)
- Action bar "Открыть папку" → `openFolder` = expand without collapsing + inspect.

And add long-press via `combinedClickable` so users can inspect without toggling.

Also, should I add real navigation into a subfolder (like a directory browser with breadcrumb + "вверх")? That would be a bigger UI change and would conflict with the existing tree+expand model. The tree model already IS the navigation. I think making the tree work correctly + fixing the toggle/inspect conflict is the right scope. But let me ask the user, since "открытие папок" is ambiguous and I want to also confirm the "libraries" part.

Now, part 2: "добавь реальные встроенные node js и другие библиотеки которые агент сам скачает при необходимости если мне памяти достаточно а то у него уж много bash но пустышек"

Translation: "add real built-in node js and other libraries that the agent will download itself when needed, if memory/disk is enough for me. He has a lot of bash but stubs."

So the user wants:
1. Real Node.js (not Rhino-pretending-to-be-node) — the fundamental issue is Rhino 1.8.1 can't parse modern JS (class/async/import), so npm packages mostly fail.
2. Other libraries.
3. Agent self-downloads on demand (this already exists for npm, but is broken by the parser limitation).
4. Fill in the bash stubs.

Options for real Node on Android:
- **QuickJS (quickjs-android / quickjs-ng AAR)** — real ES2023 engine, tiny (~2MB), fast, runs modern JS. Available as a prebuilt AAR from jitpack: `com.whl.quickjs:quickjs-android`. But needs network at build time to resolve, and adds JNI.
- **GraalJS** — heavy (~30MB+), Truffle, very large.
- **Hermes** — React Native's engine, exposed via `hermes-android` AAR; lacks the host object API surface but can be used with JSI... complex.
- **Rhino with newer version** — Rhino 1.8.1 is from 2021. There are newer forks. Rhino does support `class` since... no, Rhino doesn't support ES6 classes even in the latest. Latest Rhino is 1.7.15 (2024). So no.
- **V8 JNI** — huge (~10-20MB per ABI).
- **duktape** — old ES5/ES2015 partial.

Best fit: **QuickJS via a prebuilt AAR** — that's what actually delivers "real node js with modern npm packages".

Let me also check build.gradle.kts to see the dependency setup and size limits.

     /** Executes one tool call; never throws — errors come back as text. */
     fun execute(name: String, argsJson: String): String {
         return try {
             val args = JSONObject(argsJson.ifBlank { "{}" })
             // Manual confirmation gate: mutating tools ask the user first.
             val approver = toolApprover
             if (approver != null && !isReadOnly(name, args)) {
                 if (!approver(name, argsJson)) return "(отклонено пользователем)"
             }
             when (name) {
                 "bash" -> doBash(args)
                 "read" -> doRead(args)
                 "write" -> doWrite(args)
                 "edit" -> doEdit(args)
                 "list" -> doList(args)
                 "glob" -> doGlob(args)
                 "grep" -> doGrep(args)
                 "apply_patch" -> doApplyPatch(args)
                 "todowrite" -> doTodoWrite(args)
                 "webfetch" -> doWebFetch(args)
                 "skill" -> doSkill(args)
                 "question" -> doQuestion(args)
                 "github" -> doGitHub(args)
                 else -> "unknown tool: $name"
             }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }
 
     /** True when the call cannot change anything (auto-approved in manual mode). */
     fun isReadOnly(name: String, args: JSONObject): Boolean = when (name) {
         "read", "list", "glob", "grep", "webfetch", "skill", "question", "todowrite" -> true
         "github" -> args.optString("op") in GitHubClient.READ_OPS
         else -> false
     }

     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
         val command = args.getString("command")
         val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
         val out = buildString {
             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
         }
         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
     }

     private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.getString("filePath")
         if (path.isBlank()) return "error: пустой путь"
         val f = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
         f.writeText(args.optString("content", ""), Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "wrote ${args.optString("content", "").length} chars to ${workspace.relativeTo(f)}"
     }
 
     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         val old = args.getString("oldString")
         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
         }
         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
     }
 
     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
     }
 
     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (f.isFile) {
                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
             }
         }
         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
             .take(200)
             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
     }
 
     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
         val out = StringBuilder()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
             if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
             if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
             val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
             text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
                 if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
             }
         }
         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
     }
 
     private fun doApplyPatch(args: JSONObject): String {
         return try {
             val result = ApplyPatch.apply(args.getString("patchText")) { path -> resolve(path) }
             buildString {
                 if (result.applied.isNotEmpty()) appendLine(result.applied.joinToString("\n"))
                 if (result.skipped.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("skipped: " + result.skipped.joinToString("; "))
             }.trim().ifEmpty { "патч не содержал операций" }
         } catch (e: ApplyPatch.PatchException) {
             "error: ${e.message}"
         }
     }
 
     private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
         val arr = args.optJSONArray("todos") ?: return "error: нужен массив todos"
         val list = mutableListOf<Sessions.Todo>()
         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
             val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
             val content = o.optString("content")
             if (content.isEmpty()) continue
             val status = o.optString("status", "pending")
             list += Sessions.Todo(
                 id = o.optString("id").ifEmpty { "t$i" },
                 content = content,
                 status = if (status in listOf("pending", "in_progress", "completed")) status else "pending",
             )
         }
         todos = list
         onTodos?.invoke(list)
         return "todos updated: ${list.size}"
     }
 
     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
         val url = args.getString("url")
         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
         return try {
             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
             val status = conn.responseCode
             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
             val text = stripHtml(body)
             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }
 
     private fun doSkill(args: JSONObject): String {
         val name = args.getString("name")
         val skill = skills.load(name, projectDir)
             ?: return "error: навык '$name' не найден. Доступны: ${skills.discover(projectDir).joinToString(", ") { it.name }.ifEmpty { "(нет)" }}"
         return skill.content.take(32 * 1024)
     }
 
     private fun doQuestion(args: JSONObject): String {
         val arr = args.optJSONArray("questions") ?: return "error: нужен массив questions"
         val questions = mutableListOf<Question>()
         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
             val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
             val opts = o.optJSONArray("options") ?: JSONArray()
             questions += Question(
                 header = o.optString("header").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                 question = o.optString("question").ifEmpty { "Вопрос" },
                 options = (0 until opts.length()).map { opts.optString(it) },
             )
         }
         if (questions.isEmpty()) return "error: нет вопросов"
         val asker = questionAsker ?: return "(вопросы недоступны в этом режиме)"
         return asker(questions)
     }
 
     private fun doGitHub(args: JSONObject): String {
         if (githubToken.isBlank()) {
             return "error: GitHub-токен не задан — откройте ⚙ → GitHub и вставьте PAT (scopes repo, workflow)"
         }
         val gh = GitHubClient(githubToken)
         val op = args.optString("op")
         return try {
             when (op) {
                 "me" -> gh.me()
                 "repo_list" -> gh.repoList()
                 "repo_create" -> gh.repoCreate(
                     name = args.getString("name"),
                     private = args.optBoolean("private", true),
                     description = args.optString("description").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                 )
                 "push" -> {
                     val arr = args.optJSONArray("files") ?: return "error: нужен массив files[{path,content}]"
                     val files = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
                     for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
                         val f = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
                         val p = f.optString("path")
                         if (p.isNotEmpty()) files += p to f.optString("content")
                     }
                     if (files.isEmpty()) return "error: files пуст"
                     gh.pushFiles(args.getString("repo"), files, args.optString("message", "update"), args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 }
                 "file_get" -> gh.fileGet(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("path"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 "file_delete" -> {
                     val arr = args.optJSONArray("paths")
                         ?: return "error: нужен массив paths[]"
                     val paths = (0 until arr.length()).mapNotNull { arr.optString(it).takeIf { p -> p.isNotEmpty() } }
                     if (paths.isEmpty()) return "error: paths пуст"
                     gh.deleteFiles(
                         args.getString("repo"), paths,
                         args.optString("message", "remove files"),
                         args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                     )
                 }
                 "workflow_create" -> gh.workflowCreate(args.getString("repo"), args.optString("filename", "run.yml"), args.getString("yaml"))
                 "dispatch" -> gh.dispatch(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("workflow"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 "runs" -> gh.runs(args.getString("repo"), args.optInt("limit", 10))
                 "run_wait" -> gh.runWait(
                     repo = args.getString("repo"),
                     runId = args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L },
                     timeoutSec = args.optInt("timeout_sec", 600),
                     isCancelled = { cancelCheck?.invoke() == true },
                 )
                 "run_cancel" -> gh.runCancel(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "logs" -> gh.logs(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "artifacts" -> gh.artifacts(args.getString("repo"), args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L })
                 "artifact_download" -> gh.artifactDownload(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("artifact_id"))
                 "api" -> gh.api(args.optString("method", "GET"), args.getString("api_path"), args.optString("body").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 else -> "error: неизвестная операция '$op' (me, repo_list, repo_create, push, file_delete, file_get, workflow_create, dispatch, runs, run_wait, run_cancel, logs, artifacts, artifact_download, api)"
             }
         } catch (e: GitHubClient.GitHubException) {
             "error: ${e.message}"
         }
     }
 
     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
 
     private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())
 
     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
         var count = 0
         var idx = 0
         while (true) {
             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
             if (idx < 0) return count
             count++
             idx += needle.length
         }
     }
 
     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
         val regex = buildString {
             append('^')
             var i = 0
             while (i < pattern.length) {
                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
                     '?' -> append('.')
                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
                 }
                 i++
             }
             append('$')
         }
         return Regex(regex)
     }
 
     private fun stripHtml(html: String): String {
         return html
             .replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<!--.*?-->"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<br[^>]*>|</p>|</div>|</li>"), "\n")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<[^>]+>"), " ")
             .replace(" ", " ").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">").replace(""", "\"").replace("'", "'")
             .replace(Regex("[ \\t\\x0B\\f\\r]+"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("\\n\\s*\\n+"), "\n")
             .trim()
     }
 }

--- android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/opencode/OpenCodeToolsReadTest.kt	
+++ android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/opencode/OpenCodeToolsReadTest.kt	
@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode
+
+import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
+import dev.pocketrun.runtime.js.JsRuntime
+import dev.pocketrun.runtime.npm.NpxRuntime
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Rule
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
+import java.io.File
+
+/**
+ * Reading a file longer than one tool result.
+ *
+ * The 60 KB test file used to come back cut at 32 KB with "обрезано" and nothing
+ * else, so the model believed it had reached the end of the file and never asked
+ * for more. Every page has to say where it is, how much is left and what offset
+ * to pass next - otherwise paging is guesswork.
+ */
+class OpenCodeToolsReadTest {
+
+    @get:Rule
+    val tmp = TemporaryFolder()
+
+    private fun bootSource(): String {
+        val candidates = listOf(
+            File("src/main/assets/node/boot.js"),
+            File("app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js"),
+        )
+        return candidates.firstOrNull { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) ?: error("boot.js not found")
+    }
+
+    private class Harness(val tools: OpenCodeTools, val projectDir: File)
+
+    private fun newTools(): Harness {
+        val ws = Workspace.at(tmp.newFolder())
+        val project = File(ws.root, "proj").apply { mkdirs() }
+        val js = JsRuntime(bootSource(), ws, maxRunMs = 10_000)
+        return Harness(OpenCodeTools(ws, js, NpxRuntime(js, ws), project), project)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun shortFileIsReturnedWholeAndSaysItIsTheEnd() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        File(h.projectDir, "small.txt").writeText("alpha\nbeta\n")
+
+        val out = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"small.txt"}""")
+
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("alpha"))
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("beta"))
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("это конец файла"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun longFileIsPagedAndTheNextOffsetIsGiven() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        // Comfortably past the 32 KB a single result may carry.
+        val lines = (1..3000).map { "line $it ${"x".repeat(20)}" }
+        File(h.projectDir, "long.txt").writeText(lines.joinToString("\n"))
+
+        val first = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"long.txt"}""")
+
+        assertTrue("the file size must be stated", first.contains("3000 строк"))
+        assertFalse("a cut page must not claim to be the end", first.contains("это конец файла"))
+        assertTrue("the continuation must be spelled out", first.contains("offset="))
+        assertTrue(first, first.contains("line 1 "))
+
+        val next = Regex("""offset=(\d+)""").find(first)!!.groupValues[1].toInt()
+        assertTrue("offset must point past what was returned", next > 1)
+
+        val second = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"long.txt","offset":$next}""")
+        assertTrue(second, second.contains("line $next "))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun pagingThroughTheWholeFileReachesEveryLine() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        val lines = (1..2000).map { "row $it ${"y".repeat(30)}" }
+        File(h.projectDir, "all.txt").writeText(lines.joinToString("\n"))
+
+        var offset = 1
+        var guard = 0
+        val seen = StringBuilder()
+        while (guard++ < 50) {
+            val page = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"all.txt","offset":$offset}""")
+            seen.append(page).append('\n')
+            if (page.contains("это конец файла")) break
+            val m = Regex("""offset=(\d+)""").find(page) ?: break
+            offset = m.groupValues[1].toInt()
+        }
+
+        // Every line of the file must have been handed over, not just the head.
+        assertTrue("row 1 missing", seen.contains("row 1 "))
+        assertTrue("last row missing", seen.contains("row 2000 "))
+        assertTrue("paging gave up early", seen.contains("это конец файла"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun explicitLimitIsHonouredAndStillReportsWhatFollows() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        File(h.projectDir, "many.txt").writeText((1..500).joinToString("\n") { "n $it" })
+
+        val out = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"many.txt","limit":10}""")
+
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("n 1"))
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("n 10"))
+        assertFalse("the limit was not applied", out.contains("n 11 "))
+        assertFalse(out, out.contains("это конец файла"))
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("490"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun aSingleLineLongerThanTheBudgetIsCutAndSaysSo() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        File(h.projectDir, "long-line.txt").writeText("z".repeat(80_000) + "\ntail\n")
+
+        val out = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"long-line.txt"}""")
+
+        assertTrue("the cut must be announced", out.contains("обрезана"))
+        assertTrue("the next page must be offered", out.contains("offset=2"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun binaryIsRefusedInsteadOfMangled() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        File(h.projectDir, "blob.bin").writeBytes(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 0, 3, 4, 5))
+
+        val out = h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"blob.bin"}""")
+
+        assertTrue(out, out.contains("двоичный"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun emptyFileIsNotAnError() {
+        val h = newTools()
+        File(h.projectDir, "empty.txt").writeText("")
+
+        assertEquals("(пусто)", h.tools.execute("read", """{"filePath":"empty.txt"}""").substringAfter("---\n"))
+    }
+}

 /**
- * Rebuilds the tree, but only when the folder really changed: a fingerprint
- * of names, sizes and times is cheap enough to run every couple of seconds,
- * while building thousands of nodes is not.
+ * Rebuilds the tree, but only when the result would actually differ: a
+ * fingerprint of names, sizes and times is cheap enough to run every couple
+ * of seconds, while building thousands of nodes is not.
+ *
+ * The fingerprint alone is not enough to decide that. It describes the disk
+ * and says nothing about what the user asked to see, so opening a folder or
+ * typing in the filter - both of which change the answer without touching a
+ * single byte on disk - compared equal to the previous stamp and the tree
+ * was never rebuilt. That is why "Открыть папку" did nothing: the row
+ * flipped to an open-folder icon with no children under it. The view state
+ * is therefore part of the stamp.
  */
 private fun rebuildTree(force: Boolean = false) {
     val dir = _selected.value?.dir
     if (dir == null) {
         treePrint = ""
         if (_tree.value.isNotEmpty()) _tree.value = emptyList()
         return
     }
-    val print = FileTree.fingerprint(dir)
+    val expanded = _expandedDirs.value
+    val filter = _treeFilter.value
+    val print = treeStamp(dir, expanded, filter)
     if (!force && print == treePrint) return
     treePrint = print
-    _tree.value = FileTree.build(dir, _expandedDirs.value, _treeFilter.value)
+    _tree.value = FileTree.build(dir, expanded, filter)
 }
 
+/** Everything the tree is a function of: the disk, what is open, what is filtered. */
+private fun treeStamp(dir: File, expanded: Set<String>, filter: TreeFilter): String =
+    buildString {
+        append(FileTree.fingerprint(dir))
+        append('|')
+        append(filter.query).append('\u0000').append(filter.kind).append('\u0000').append(filter.showHidden)
+        append('|')
+        expanded.sorted().forEach { append(it).append('\u0001') }
+    }
+
 /** Any directory walk happens off the main thread: a project can be big. */
 private fun rebuildTreeAsync(force: Boolean = false) {
     ioExecutor.execute { rebuildTree(force) }
 }

OK, `MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT` is only used for bash and grep, not read. Good — read uses MAX_READ=32KB.

Now the fix for read: instead of truncating with a dead-end "… (обрезано)", report the file's real size and give the exact continuation offset, and when `limit` isn't given, default it to a page size so the agent naturally pages.

Let me write it.

input.oldString:
private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
        val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
        if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
        val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
        val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
        val lines = text.lines()
        val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
        val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
        val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
        val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
        return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
            .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
    }

     *
     * The whole result used to be cut at [MAX_READ] with a bare "обрезано" and
     * nothing else: the model was told the file had ended, so a 60 KB source was

        val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"

        if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
        if (f.length() > MAX_READ_BYTES && !looksTextual(f)) {

Now I understand the copy problem:
- `combinedClickable` on the Surface with `onLongClick` copies the WHOLE `text` parameter. That's the "копирует не определенные строки что выбрал а все что писал агент" complaint — long-press copies everything, ignoring what the user selected.
- Also the long-press gesture conflicts with text selection — you can't easily select text because the Surface consumes clicks.
- And there's no explicit copy button.

Fix:
1. Wrap bubble text in `SelectionContainer` so the user can select specific text.
2. Add an explicit copy button (icon) on each bubble — copies whole message.
3. When text IS selected, the "copy" action should copy the selection. In Compose, `SelectionContainer` + system "Copy" from the text toolbar does this natively. But they want a button.

Best approach: 
- Wrap content in `SelectionContainer` so native selection + toolbar Copy works (copies only selection).
- Remove the long-press-to-copy-everything on the Surface (which fights selection), replace with a small visible copy button in the bubble.

Let me implement:
- `CopyableSurface`: wrap content in `SelectionContainer`, and render a copy IconButton. Keep long-press copy as a convenience but it should copy selection if any... Compose's `SelectionController` can give the selection but copying a selection programmatically isn't cleanly exposed. The native text selection toolbar already handles "copy selection". So:
  - `SelectionContainer` → user selects → Android's floating toolbar has "Копировать" → copies only selection. ✓
  - Explicit copy button → copies whole message. ✓
  - Drop the `combinedClickable` long-press (it competes with selection drag).

That directly addresses both complaints.

package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
import dev.pocketrun.runtime.js.JsRuntime
import dev.pocketrun.runtime.npm.NpxRuntime
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

/**
 * The manual-confirmation gate: read-only tools run without asking, mutating
 * tools ask the approver and respect its verdict; the github tool degrades to
 * a clear error without a token.
 */
class OpenCodeToolsGateTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun bootSource(): String {
        val candidates = listOf(
            File("src/main/assets/node/boot.js"),
            File("app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js"),
        )
        return candidates.firstOrNull { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) ?: error("boot.js not found")
    }

    private class Harness(val tools: OpenCodeTools, val projectDir: File)

    private fun newTools(githubToken: String = ""): Harness {
        val ws = Workspace.at(tmp.newFolder())
        val project = File(ws.root, "proj").apply { mkdirs() }
        val js = JsRuntime(bootSource(), ws, maxRunMs = 10_000)
        return Harness(OpenCodeTools(ws, js, NpxRuntime(js, ws), project, githubToken), project)
    }

Готово — 4 бага исправлены, закоммичено как `45428bd`. Сборка и все тесты зелёные.

**Что было сломано**

1. **Кнопка «Открыть папку» не работала.** `rebuildTree` пропускал пересборку, если отпечаток диска не изменился — а он считал только имена/размеры/время и ничего не знал про раскрытые папки и фильтры. Иконка менялась на «открытую», детей не появлялось. Тот же баг глушил и поиск по имени, и чипы типов, и переключатель скрытых файлов. Теперь отпечаток включает и состояние вида (`FileTree.stamp`).
2. **Долгое нажатие на строку было объявлено, но не подключено** — нельзя было посмотреть файл, не открыв его. Подключил `combinedClickable`.
3. **Копирование.** Одно долгое нажатие всегда копировало весь ответ агента, выделить пару строк было нельзя. Теперь текст выделяется (`SelectionContainer`) + кнопка копирует только это сообщение.
4. **Обрезание больших файлов** (это был твой `hub.yml`): `read` резал на 32 КБ и писал «обрезано» — агент считал, что файл кончился, и 61 КБ видел только до середины. Теперь страницы: сколько строк всего, какое окно показано, точный `offset` для следующей.
5. **Панель плана** рисовала 12 пунктов из скольких угодно без скролла — отсюда «видна десятая часть». Теперь все пункты + счётчик + в правой колонке на широком экране, сворачивается на телефоне.

**Про твои остальные вопросы**

- **Node/npm.** Реальный node уже нет — это Rhino 1.8.1 + самописный слой в `boot.js` (46 КБ). npm-пакеты качаются по требованию, но ~все современные падают: Rhino не умеет парсить `class`/`async`/`import`. Нужен QuickJS — это замена движка, ~+2 МБ к APK. Скажи, делать.
- **Заглушки в bash** — да, `env` возвращает две строки, `uname` всегда «Linux aarch64», `which` рисует несуществующий `/bin`, `echo` без `-e`/`-n`. Нет `git`, `curl`, `jq`, `sed`, `awk`. Позже.
- **Картинки/аудио.** Сейчас `LlmClient` вообще не умеет мультимодальность — только текст. Поэтому агент физически не видит изображения, даже если модель это умеет. Превью в чате + скачать/отправить/перегенерировать/сменить промт — это отдельная фича, ей нужен выбор провайдера картинок и ключ.
- **Про «глобально»:** ничего глобального. Всё в песочнице приложения, `Workspace.resolve` + аудит-хуки Python не дают выйти наружу. Наружу выходят только шеры файлов, установка APK-обновления и запросы в сеть. Реально широко — инструмент `github`: с твоим PAT агент может запускать шелл на чужих CI-раннерах.

--- android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/runtime/npm/RealPackageTest.kt

+package dev.pocketrun.runtime.npm
+
+import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
+import dev.pocketrun.runtime.ExecRequest
+import dev.pocketrun.runtime.RuntimeKind
+import dev.pocketrun.runtime.js.JsRuntime
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Rule
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
+import java.io.File
+import java.net.InetAddress
+import java.net.ServerSocket
+
+/**
+ * The real installer against the real npm registry, running a real package.
+ *
+ * Everything else in this suite fakes the registry, which is right for testing
+ * resolution rules but useless for the question that actually matters: does a
+ * package written in modern JavaScript load? semver and ora are both CommonJS and
+ * both use `class` (ora also uses `async`/`await`) - on Rhino every one of them
+ * was a hard parse error, so a user could install them and never run them.
+ *
+ * Skipped when the registry cannot be reached, so an offline CI run is not a
+ * failure. The syntax itself is covered without a network by ModernSyntaxTest.
+ */
+class RealPackageTest {
+
+    @get:Rule
+    val tmp = TemporaryFolder()
+
+    private fun bootSource(): String = listOf(
+        File("src/main/assets/node/boot.js"),
+        File("app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js"),
+    ).firstOrNull { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) ?: error("boot.js not found")
+
+    /** A one-pixel PNG, so the offline/online switch cannot depend on real fetches twice. */
+    private fun registryUp(): Boolean = try {
+        ServerSocket(0, 1, InetAddress.getByName("registry.npmjs.org")).use { true }
+    } catch (_: Throwable) {
+        false
+    }
+
+    private fun run(ws: Workspace, npx: NpxRuntime, spec: String, script: String): String {
+        val parsed = NpxRuntime.parseSpec(spec) ?: error("cannot parse $spec")
+        npx.install(parsed)
+
+        val js = JsRuntime(bootSource(), ws, maxRunMs = 30_000)
+        val main = File(ws.root, "main.js").apply { writeText(script, Charsets.UTF_8) }
+        val result = js.executeSync(
+            ExecRequest(RuntimeKind.NODE, main.absolutePath, emptyList(), ws.root),
+            25_000,
+        )
+        assertEquals("$spec stderr: ${result.stderr}", 0, result.exitCode)
+        return result.stdout
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun semverLoadsAndComparesVersions() {
+        if (!registryUp()) return
+        val ws = Workspace.at(tmp.newFolder())
+        val js = JsRuntime(bootSource(), ws, maxRunMs = 30_000)
+        val out = run(
+            ws, NpxRuntime(js, ws), "semver@7.6.3",
+            """
+            const semver = require('semver');
+            console.log('gt:' + semver.gt('2.0.0', '1.9.9'));
+            console.log('sat:' + semver.satisfies('1.2.3', '^1.0.0'));
+            console.log('kind:' + typeof semver.SemVer);
+            console.log('instance:' + (new semver.SemVer('3.4.5') instanceof semver.SemVer));
+            console.log('major:' + new semver.SemVer('3.4.5').major);
+            """.trimIndent(),
+        )
+        assertTrue("stdout: $out", out.contains("gt:true"))
+        assertTrue("stdout: $out", out.contains("sat:true"))
+        assertTrue("stdout: $out", out.contains("kind:function"))
+        assertTrue("stdout: $out", out.contains("instance:true"))
+        assertTrue("stdout: $out", out.contains("major:3"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun oraLoadsWithClassesAndAsyncAwait() {
+        if (!registryUp()) return
+        val ws = Workspace.at(tmp.newFolder())
+        val js = JsRuntime(bootSource(), ws, maxRunMs = 30_000)
+        val out = run(
+            ws, NpxRuntime(js, ws), "ora@5.4.1",
+            """
+            const ora = require('ora');
+            const spinner = ora({ text: 'работаю', isEnabled: false });
+            console.log('type:' + typeof spinner);
+            console.log('text:' + spinner.text);
+            console.log('has-start:' + (typeof spinner.start === 'function'));
+            (async function () {
+                await Promise.resolve();
+                const level = spinner.level !== undefined ? 'has-level' : 'no-level';
+                console.log(level);
+                process.exit(0);
+            })();
+            """.trimIndent(),
+        )
+        assertTrue("stdout: $out", out.contains("type:object"))

README.md
quickjs-android
Download
quickjs-android 是 QuickJS JavaScript 引擎的 Android 接口框架，整体基于面向对象设计，提供了自动GC功能，使用简单。armeabi-v7a 的大小仅 350KB，是 Google V8 不错的替代品，启动速度比 V8 快，内存占用更低，支持 ES2020 。
* armeabi-v7a 平台下，整体占用apk空间仅 350KB；
* JS对象自动GC，无需手动释放；
* 支持 ES6 Module，可以使用 import、export 函数；
* 支持 Node.js 的 CommonJS 规范，可以使用 require、exports 函数；
* 支持绑定 Java 注解函数；
* 支持通过 Java Function Callback 函数注册JS函数；
* 内置 Event Queue，开发者可以在任意线程执行代码，无需关心JS单线程问题；

QuickJS quickJS = QuickJS.createRuntime();
JSContext context = quickJS.createContext();

Maven Central
Run your JavaScript code in Kotlin, asynchronously.
The async eval demo
This is a QuickJS binding for idiomatic Kotlin, inspired by Cash App's Zipline (previously Duktape Android) but with more flexibility.
Another QuickJS wrapper?
There are a few QuickJS wrappers for Android already. Some written in Java are not Kotlin Multiplatform friendly, and some lack updates.
Zipline is great and KMP-friendly, but it focuses on running Kotlin/JS modules. Its API is limited to running arbitrary JavaScript code with platform bindings.
That's why I created this library, with some good features:
* Simple and idiomatic Kotlin APIs, it's easy to define binding and evaluate arbitrary code
* Highly integrated with Kotlin Coroutines , it is async and suspend ed. See #Async
* Kotlin Multiplatform targets, including Android , JVM and Kotlin/Native
* Lazy modules, loaded on demand with optional bytecode caching. See Modules
* Interruption, with cancellation, timeouts, and manual interrupts. See Interrupting evaluations
* Mixed Kotlin and native bindings in the same QuickJS runtime. See Native context access
* The latest version of QuickJS
Usages
Installation
In build.gradle.kts :
implementation("io.github.dokar3:quickjs-kt:<VERSION>")
Or in libs.versions.toml :
quickjs-kt = { module = "io.github.dokar3:quickjs-kt", version = "<VERSION>" }
Android unit tests
A desktop JVM cannot load the Android native library, so local unit tests need the -jvm artifact instead:
configurations.matching { it.name.endsWith("UnitTestRuntimeClasspath") }.configureEach {
resolutionStrategy.dependencySubstitution {
substitute(module("io.github.dokar3:quickjs-kt-android"))
.using(module("io.github.dokar3:quickjs-kt-jvm:<VERSION>"))
}

With DSL:
quickJs {
define("console") {
function("log") { args ->
println(args.joinToString(" "))
}
}
}
Binding classes need to be added to Android's ProGuard rules files.
-keep class com.example.Console { *; }
-keep class com.example.Http { *; }
Async
This library gives you the ability to define async functions . Within the QuickJs instance, a coroutine scope is created to launch async jobs, a job Dispatcher can also be passed when creating the instance.
evaluate() and quickJs{} are suspend functions, which make your async jobs await in the caller scope."

393:     /**
394:      * Synchronous http(s) for the boot.js `http`/`https` modules. Returns
395:      * `{"status":…,"headers":{…},"body":"…"}` as JSON text, or null on any
396:      * failure (boot.js turns that into a request 'error' event).
397:      */
398:     private fun httpBridge(method: String, url: String, headersJson: String, body: String?): String? {
399:         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return null
400:         return try {
401:             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
402:             conn.requestMethod = method
403:             conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
404:             conn.readTimeout = 60_000
405:             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
406:             runCatching { JSONObject(headersJson) }.getOrNull()?.let { h ->
407:                 for (key in h.keys()) conn.setRequestProperty(key, h.getString(key))
408:             }
409:             // An empty string means "no body" (boot.js passes '' for GET): setting
410:             // doOutput on a GET silently turns it into POST in HttpURLConnection.
411:             if (!body.isNullOrEmpty()) {
412:                 conn.doOutput = true
413:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Length", body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size.toString())
414:                 conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
415:             }
416:             val status = conn.responseCode
417:             val text = readCapped(conn, status)
418:             val headers = JSONObject()
419:             for ((k, v) in conn.headerFields) {
420:                 if (k != null && !v.isNullOrEmpty()) headers.put(k, v.joinToString(", "))
421:             }
422:             JSONObject()
423:                 .put("status", status)
424:                 .put("headers", headers)
425:                 .put("body", text)
426:                 .toString()
427:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
428:             Log.w(TAG, "http $method $url failed: ${t.message}")
429:             null
430:         }
431:     }
432: 
433:     private fun readCapped(conn: HttpURLConnection, status: Int): String {
434:         val stream = if (status in 200..399) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream ?: return ""
435:         return stream.use { input ->
436:             val out = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
437:             val buf = ByteArray(16 * 1024)
438:             var total = 0
439:             while (total < MAX_HTTP_BODY) {
440:                 val n = input.read(buf)
441:                 if (n < 0) break
442:                 out.write(buf, 0, n)
443:                 total += n
444:             }
445:             out.toString("UTF-8")
446:         }
447:     }
448: 
449:     /** Forwards tailer output and keeps a capped copy for the final ExecResult. */
450:     private class CaptureListener(
451:         private val downstream: OutputListener,
452:         private val capture: Capture,
453:     ) : OutputListener {
454:         override fun onOutput(stream: OutputStream, text: String) {
455:             capture.append(text)
456:             downstream.onOutput(stream, text)
457:         }
458:     }
459: 
460:     private class Capture {
461:         private val builder = StringBuilder()
462:         var truncated = false
463:             private set
464: 
465:         fun append(text: String) {
466:             if (truncated) return
467:             val room = MAX_CAPTURE - builder.length
468:             if (room <= 0) { truncated = true; return }
469:             if (text.length <= room) builder.append(text) else {
470:                 builder.append(text, 0, room)
471:                 truncated = true
472:             }
473:         }
474: 
475:         fun text(): String = builder.toString()
476:     }

- `QuickJS.createRuntime()` → `createContext()`
- `ctx.executeStringScript(code, fileName)` — evaluates
- `ctx.getObject("__pr").registerJavaMethod(callback, "name")` — the bridge, exactly matching the current `installBridge`
- `obj.executeDoubleFunction("__prPending", JSArray)` — the event loop
- Returns `Object` with String/Double/Boolean/JSArray
- Uses `org.json.JSONObject` — already a project dependency!

This maps almost perfectly onto the existing structure. `null` handling: JavaCallback returns Object; returning null → probably JS null. Need to verify.
